title: Battle of Añyraqai
text: The Battle of Añyraqai, also known as the Battle of Anrakai, was a legendary military battle between the Kazakh Khanate and the Dzungar Khanate in April 1730. The Kazakhs defeated the Dzungars and expelled them from the northwestern part of Jetisu. This led to the Kazakhs resettling on the Ili River.
